_about: Reference values the auditor checks barcode data against. Edit by hand, then run npm run build. Checks that use this file only warn or add a note, so a missing entry never fails a label.

postcodeStates._about: Postcode ranges for each state, written start-end. A postcode printed with a state outside its range raises a warning.

sharedPostcodes._about: Postcodes used on both sides of a state border. Add any others you come across.

testMlids._about: Australia Post's test MLIDs, from Parcel Post and Express Post v1.4 page 6. Fine on test labels, never on production labels.

gs1AustraliaPrefixes._about: GS1 Australia company prefixes start 930 to 939. An SSCC with another prefix is allowed, but unusual for an Australian merchant.
